title: getapirestrictions_should_return_current_restriction_list
description: Verify that GET /api/restrictions returns the current list of restricted apps with status 200.

title: postapirestrictions_should_add_new_restriction_with_valid_data
description: Verify that POST /api/restrictions with a valid package name and daily limit adds a new restriction and returns status 201.

title: postapirestrictions_should_reject_invalid_package_names
description: Verify that POST /api/restrictions with invalid or empty package names returns status 400 and does not change the restriction list.

title: putapirestrictionspackagename_should_update_existing_restriction
description: Verify that PUT /api/restrictions/{packageName} updates the daily limit for the specified app and returns status 200.

title: deleteapirestrictionspackagename_should_remove_restriction
description: Verify that DELETE /api/restrictions/{packageName} removes the restriction and returns status 200.

title: getapiusagecurrent_should_return_active_foreground_app_usage
description: Verify that GET /api/usage/current returns the current foreground app package and usage state with status 200 when permissions are granted.

title: getapiusagecurrent_should_return_403_when_permissions_missing
description: Verify that GET /api/usage/current returns status 403 when usage stats or accessibility permissions are missing.

title: postapiblockingcheck_should_indicate_block_needed_when_limit_reached
description: Verify that POST /api/blocking/check returns status 200 indicating block is needed when usage exceeds daily limit.

title: postapiblockingshow_should_display_overlay_when_permission_granted
description: Verify that POST /api/blocking/show displays the blocking overlay and returns status 200 when overlay permission is granted.

title: postapiunblockstart_and_confirm_should_unlock_after_five_second_hold
description: Verify that POST /api/unblock/start followed by POST /api/unblock/confirm after a five-second hold disables monitoring and unlocks the app with status 200.
